note: Queries for the recall eval. Recall queries are keyword-shaped on purpose: facts.py builds an FTS5 MATCH in which EVERY query token must occur in the fact, so a query using words the fact does not contain returns zero results. That is a real limitation of the retriever, documented by the paraphrase canary below — not a bug in these queries. expected_text must match a fixture fact verbatim.

InstaBox Free pauses the machine after 30 minutes idle.
The daily summary runs at 07:00 IST.
The keep-alive Worker pings every 5 minutes.
